archetypes.purpose: Show the actual sellable product as the primary listing image.
Explain a user-relevant feature that is supported by confirmed product information.
Show a useful close-up or construction detail visible in the supplied references.
Place the product in a use context that helps the buyer understand its role.
Communicate product dimensions or scale using confirmed measurements or a clear comparison.
Show a real setup, use, or care step when that step is supported by product information.
Show included contents or packaging when they are part of the offer.
Compare only supported attributes of this product without inventing competitor claims.
Present a selectable color, size, or configuration that belongs to this listing.

Express a product-specific visual task not covered by another archetype. Define its title, purpose, reason, preserved elements, and intended changes in the ShotSpec rather than adding a product-category template.
suggested_evidence: user intent or explicit task requirement
